answer: Proof of Personhood protocols utilize biometric entropy to map digital identities to unique physical entities, creating a dense grove of verifiable nodes. By tying consensus weight to a thread of decentralized attestations rather than compute, the network forces an attacker to acquire costly, verified human identities for every new agent. Like the trajectory of a comet, an attempt to mass-produce identities creates a visible, expensive distortion in the global registry, rendering Sybil expansion economically infeasible.
